description: 정보통신산업진흥원_글로벌ICT포털_품목별보고서 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 정보통신산업진흥원. 글로벌ICT포털(GIP)에서 제공하는 20여개 품목별 ICT 시장동향, 해외진출전략 가이드을 통해 글로벌 ICT 전문정보를 확인하실 수 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 정보통신산업진흥원. Its tags are ICT, 품목, 시장동향, 재정금융. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2024-09-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
